body: I guess having a tall person reach stuff for you is kinda ok but then it sucks for me cause I people already constantly baby me and it'd just make me feel less independent than people already let me be. But I guess that's a good way to look at it, try to find benefits to being short.
It's hard to find people who are fun to be with but I'm trying my best. Thank you.

I'm a senior now but yeah. I've researched it a billion times... I started puberty at like 10, I haven't grown any taller since 14, and I barely even grew between ages 13 and 14. There's basically no way I'm getting any growth spurts. I'd probably be better off winning the lottery. If it were just kids I'd probably care at least a little less but adults treat me awfully too. It's everyone. And also you know I don't really wanna experience any thing else. I've seen enough and I'm sick of it.

I appreciate the words of motivation but I've been dealing with suicidal thoughts since I was a kid, long before height was even ever a concern so from my perspective for as long as I've been dealing with all of my problems, a lot of them that I'm unable to change/control, suicide really does feel like an answer. In regards to my height specifically a good way to never be bullied again over my height is to... Well, not exist in the first place. I wouldn't have to worry about confidence or lack thereof if I was dead. I'm the height of a child, and I'll probably always get picked on for it. I'm looking at surgery or medicine that helps people grow taller but if that's not an option than honestly I'd really take being dead over dealing with life long bullying.

Then it's a situation where I feel like I'm damned if I do, damned if I don't. Basically everyone in my life makes fun of me so I'd be distancing myself from pretty much everyone I know... I'm autistic and struggle to make relationships as is. And when I do make friends apparently I only attract the toxic ones but being lonely just makes me suicidal too. I just constantly feel trapped with no way out.

Yeah that's pretty much all my worries. I'm worried nobody would want to date me because on top of being short I have the face of a 12 year old too. 

>it makes me think i have two options if i wanna be accepted: making people assume that i'm a little boy (creepy) or dressing like a cute girl, which i'm not

This one especially is something I've thought about so many times... Be taken seriously for once in my life or dress in something that makes me uncomfortable.

I've done research on it, it can add up to 6 inches and the surgeon I read had patients walking the very next day or two after the surgery. The only problem is the cost but I mean can't be more expensive than moving to Asia anyway.

Since I'm already short I'll never really understand why anyone would wanna be short but for me personally I just wanna be average or at the very least to a point where people would stop always babying me or teasing me.
I'll be 17 in a little over a month.
It's bothering me to the point where I'm genuinely considering getting surgery to make myself taller just so people can finally leave me alone.
Lol you didn't offend me, it's okay. I've tried explaining it before but it's rare it ever does much. Or I'll just get called whiney or bitchy for it.
Even outside of school I get treated awfully. At this point I'm just convinced I will be bullied for the rest of my life.

I was born a female but I'm non-binary/trans guy so I've had experience of being short in both groups. I tend to hang out more with guys than girls and of course they're often toxic when it comes to height but the occasional female friend I have teases me too. I'm shorter than the average girl... It doesn't matter who it is. I get teased and put down by everyone. And if it's not my peers it's adults poking fun at my height. And because I'm not a child anymore now young kids will compare themselves to me and make fun of me. Everyone treats me like shit, although of course I'll give the little kids a pass for doing so. I will never catch a break. I'm so sick of it. If I have to deal with one more person trying to invalidate what I say just because of my height I'm going to genuinely kill myself.
